style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting, matching the reference image's palette: deep green-black rock, luminous teal and lime moss, pale cream and violet mushrooms with softly glowing caps. Painterly, soft, slightly muted and low contrast so it reads as scenery behind a game, with a soft dark outline and no harsh highlights. One single isolated object, centred, entirely inside the frame. Draw no ground, no floor, no characters, no text, no shadow.

frames.name: mushroom_cap_pillar
frames.prompt: A tall stack of giant mushroom caps forming a pillar rising from the ground, wide caps at the top and a thick pale stalk, gills showing, small glowing mushrooms at its foot.

frames.name: hanging_spore_moss
frames.prompt: A dense curtain of hanging spore-moss and pale threads dangling straight down from a small lump of ceiling rock, thicker at the top, dusted with drifting yellow spores.

frames.name: glowing_mushroom_cluster
frames.prompt: A cluster of five or six glowing mushrooms of different heights growing from a small mossy mound, caps in teal and violet.

frames.name: mushroom_bridge
frames.prompt: A row of three flat shelf mushrooms growing out of each other like a rising bridge, seen from the side, each with a pale glowing underside.

frames.name: vine_curtain
frames.prompt: A wide curtain of long green vines and leaves hanging straight down from the ceiling, thick at the top and loosely tapering, with a few small pale flowers.

frames.name: spore_pod
frames.prompt: A single fat spore pod on a short stalk, swollen and split at the top with soft yellow spores puffing out.

frames.name: mossy_stalactite
frames.prompt: Two or three stalactites of different lengths hanging from a lump of ceiling rock, thickly covered in green moss, one tip dripping.

frames.name: dripping_fungus_shelf
frames.prompt: A broad wavy shelf of bracket fungus jutting out sideways, with pale glowing drips hanging from its underside.
